title: An Input Skip Can Reparameterize a VAE Without Improving the Generator
abstract: arXiv:2610.37456v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: An input skip can reduce reconstruction error while leaving a model's distribution of new samples unchanged. For a Gaussian variational autoencoder (VAE) with constant input skip $0\leq\alpha<1$, a model without a skip can be written in skip form by multiplying its decoder output by $b=1-\alpha$ and its noise variance by $b^2$. The distribution of observations and latent variables and its exact generative scores stay the same, while reconstruction mean squared error (MSE) is multiplied by $b^2$. Separate training can produce different generators because optimization depends on the parameter coordinates. In a Gaussian experiment with known density, changing skip and observation variance together reduces MSE but worsens energy score and the estimate of negative log density from importance sampling. translated_title: 输入跳跃连接可在不改进生成器的情况下对VAE进行重参数化
translated_abstract: 输入跳跃连接可以在不改变模型新样本分布的情况下降低重建误差。对于具有常数输入跳跃 0≤α<1 的高斯变分自编码器（VAE），通过将其解码器输出乘以 b=1-α、噪声方差乘以 b²，可以把无跳跃连接的模型写成跳跃连接的形式。此时观测变量与潜变量的分布以及精确的生成分数保持不变，而重建均方误差（MSE）则被乘以 b²。由于优化过程依赖于参数坐标，分开训练可能产生不同的生成器。在一个密度已知的高斯实验中，同时改变跳跃与观测方差会降低MSE，但会使能量分数恶化，并使通过重要性采样得到的负对数密度估计变差。在七条年度深海海啸评估与报告浮标（DART）记录上，在相同观测方差下的能量分数差异……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 输入跳跃连接虽能降低VAE的重建误差，但本质上只是对模型的重参数化，并不改进生成器，甚至可能使生成质量指标恶化。
en_tdlr: An input skip merely reparameterizes a VAE—reducing reconstruction error without improving the generator and potentially worsening generative scores.
